Who we clean for

Built for big buildings, not just tidy rooms

This is high-ticket, contract cleaning: trained crews, documented checklists and a single point of contact for your facility manager. Pick your building type — the walkthrough shapes everything that follows.

01 / Offices & headquarters

Night crews that hand the building back ready

Desks, meeting rooms, washrooms and high-traffic floors cleaned overnight or out of hours, so Monday morning never starts with a complaint. Your walkthrough sets the scope, the frequency and the priority zones.

02 / Medical & clinical spaces

Detail-led cleaning where standards are strictest

Waiting areas, exam rooms and clinical support spaces cleaned to a documented checklist, with photo checks on the touchpoints that matter most. Clients named on the company’s site include University of Chicago Medical.

03 / Warehouses & industrial sites

Scale without shortcuts

Wide floors, racking aisles, break rooms and offices across large footprints — the kind of contract where crew size, equipment and supervision decide the result. Clients named on the company’s site include Nestlé and Eaton.

The proof system

Don’t take our word for it. Check the photos.

Most cleaning quotes ask you to trust a promise. This homepage is built around the opposite: evidence. After every visit, your facility manager gets a photo-inspection report tied to the checklist agreed at walkthrough.

  • Walkthrough first. We scope the building in person before any proposal.
  • Checklist per zone. Every area has its own tasks, not a generic sweep — ISSA-style industry checklists, adapted to your building at walkthrough.
  • Photos, not claims. Completed zones are photographed for your report.
  • Issues flagged fast. Anything found is reported, not quietly left.

Crews, equipment and supervision

How it works

From walkthrough to a building you can check

Step 1 — Walkthrough.

We walk the facility with you, note priority zones, access and schedules, and agree the checklist.

Step 2 — Clear proposal.

You receive a custom proposal for your building — scope, frequency and service plan, with no published flat-rate list to guess from.

Step 3 — First clean & photo report.

The crew cleans to the agreed checklist and photographs completed zones for your inspection report.

Step 4 — Ongoing supervision.

Regular photo-inspection reports keep standards visible, visit after visit, with service hours 24/7.

Questions facility managers ask

Straight answers, before the walkthrough

How is pricing worked out?

Pricing is custom. After a detailed facility walkthrough you receive a clear proposal based on your building, its size, its schedule and its priority zones. No fixed price list is published.

What does the photo-inspection report show?

Photographs of completed zones, tied to the checklist agreed at walkthrough, so your facility manager can verify the work without walking every floor.

What hours do you work?

Office hours are Monday–Sunday, 8:00am–6:30pm, and service hours are 24/7.

What size of facility do you take on?
